name: How long does a typical roof repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof repair depends on the extent of the damage and the type of repair needed. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few shingles or sealing a small leak, can often be completed in a few hours to a single day. More extensive repairs, involving larger sections of the roof or structural components, may take several days. We will provide a clear timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof repair time varies based on damage extent, from a few hours for minor issues to several days for extensive work.
